items.reason: The new action converts user_id to an integer and passes it directly to group.users.delete at app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:86–90; users is a scoped association (app/models/group.rb:8). [Rails 4.1.8 collection_association.rb:240](https://github.com/rails/rails/blob/v4.1.8/activerecord/lib/active_record/associations/collection_association.rb#L240) resolves integer arguments through association find, so an already-removed member raises RecordNotFound before the success response. The previous removal used a membership query that safely did nothing when absent (app/models/group.rb:276–277), making this a regression for stale lists or concurrent removals.
